task.text: Add operator role-catalog reload without a restart (CA-ISSUE-012). Read the role catalog at startup and on reload through ONE descriptor-bounded read of at most 1 MiB, decoded as strict UTF-8; keep startup failures as GenerationError ROLE_CATALOG_INVALID. Export reloadRoleCatalog(catalog: RoleCatalog, path: string): {version, roleIds, sha256}: it is synchronous from read to replace (no await, so reloads cannot interleave), parses with the existing catalog schema, replaces the catalog atomically only on success, and otherwise throws GenerationError ROLE_CATALOG_RELOAD_FAILED leaving the catalog unchanged. Add POST /roles/config/reload as an OPERATOR route: strict empty JSON body (any field is 400), re-reads only the configured ROLE_CATALOG_PATH, answers 200 {version, roleIds, sha256 of the file bytes}; 404 {code ROLE_RELOAD_DISABLED} when no path is configured; 400 {code ROLE_CATALOG_RELOAD_FAILED, error 'Configuration unchanged; check the configured file'} on any failure, echoing no file content or path. Messages already claimed keep their snapshot (existing behaviour). No watcher, no UI, no automatic reload. Make tests/unit/roleCatalogReload.test.ts and tests/integration/roleReloadHttp.test.ts pass without editing them. The server must obtain its startup catalog through the exported loadRoleCatalog, and the route must replace THAT instance in place (the HTTP oracle observes the live instance through a pass-through wrapper of loadRoleCatalog).
task.criteria: Both oracle files pass unchanged; tsc --noEmit passes; only the allowed files change (mode 100644).
